name: Comment Section
summary: Fail-closed named finite discussion with at most two visible thread levels, canonical empty/order/pagination/control composition, controlled target-configured reaction arrays, and target-owned identity, moderation and mutation lifecycle.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Named thematic discussion section, omitted when its required visible title or discussion composition is absent.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Visible localized contextual heading that names the section.

anatomy.name: count
anatomy.description: Optional target-formatted authoritative count text; never a neutral computed value or live region.

anatomy.name: toolbar
anatomy.description: Optional container for one canonical Select when the target can verify and project an alternative order.

anatomy.name: order
anatomy.description: Composition hook on the target-controlled canonical Select; it never sorts neutral DOM records.

anatomy.name: thread
anatomy.description: Native ordered list used when the required discussion slot contains comment records.

anatomy.name: item
anatomy.description: Native list item containing exactly one comment article plus, only on a top-level item, one optional reply list.

anatomy.name: comment
anatomy.description: Native article for one target-owned comment record.

anatomy.name: avatar
anatomy.description: Optional canonical passive Avatar composition for the author.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Intrinsic comment metadata, content and action wrapper.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Native comment header containing visible author and optional date.

anatomy.name: author
anatomy.description: Required visible target-supplied author label for every rendered record.

anatomy.name: date
anatomy.description: Optional native time element with visible localized text and a machine-readable datetime.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Optional target lifecycle text such as a visible moderation-pending state; it is never inferred by neutral source.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Target-sanitized comment-content boundary.

anatomy.name: replyTo
anatomy.description: Visible localized parent-context label required when a provider reply deeper than level two is flattened into the second visible level.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: One plain paragraph in the evidence composition; targets may provide other sanitized authored content.

anatomy.name: actions
anatomy.description: Native comment footer containing target-owned canonical controls.

anatomy.name: action
anatomy.description: Composition hook on a canonical Button or Link action.

anatomy.name: reactions
anatomy.description: Named group rendered only when a comment record supplies at least one target-configured reaction.

anatomy.name: reaction
anatomy.description: Standalone canonical Toggle button projection of one controlled reaction item; the wrapper intentionally is not the exclusive Toggle Group.

anatomy.name: reactionIcon
anatomy.description: Optional decorative target-owned icon that never replaces the complete localized accessible label.

anatomy.name: reactionCount
anatomy.description: Optional visible target-authoritative count hidden from the button name because the supplied reaction label is complete.

anatomy.name: replies
anatomy.description: One second-level native ordered list; it never contains another reply list.

anatomy.name: emptyState
anatomy.description: Canonical Empty State composition for a resolved valid discussion with zero records.

anatomy.name: pagination
anatomy.description: Optional canonical finite numbered Pagination after a non-empty thread.

anatomy.name: composer
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned native top-level comment form; reply controls require an authenticated target composer.

anatomy.name: composerTitle
anatomy.description: Visible heading that names the optional composer form.

anatomy.name: composerStatus
anatomy.description: Target-owned accessible error or result feedback for the native composer.

anatomy.name: composerModeration
anatomy.description: Optional truthful target moderation notice displayed before submission.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One finite target-owned discussion; records and canonical optional compositions determine its visible content.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Fluid single-column discussion with container-relative logical reply indentation.

states.name: default
states.description: Valid named discussion with one required target-owned thread or resolved empty-state composition.

states.name: resolvedEmpty
states.description: The target has resolved a valid zero-record discussion and composes canonical Empty State; loading, error, locked and unavailable are different target states.

states.name: withThread
states.description: One or more authoritative records are present in oldest-first order by default.

states.name: withReplies
states.description: Second-level replies are present; provider depths beyond two are flattened with explicit parent context.

states.name: withReactions
states.description: At least one record supplies a non-empty controlled reaction array.

states.name: withPagination
states.description: A long authoritative discussion composes canonical finite Pagination.

states.name: withComposer
states.description: An optional target-owned top-level composer is present.

behavior.name: failClosedComposition
behavior.description: A non-empty visible title and non-null target discussion slot are required. Missing either omits the complete root instead of emitting an unlabelled or context-free shell.

behavior.name: validEmptyComposition
behavior.description: A resolved valid discussion with zero records composes canonical Empty State with truthful target copy. A participation action is optional only when an authenticated composer actually exists; loading, provider error, moderation lock and unavailable are never represented as empty.

behavior.name: finiteDocumentStructure
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses ordinary finite document/list semantics with no Feed role, roving focus, custom collection keyboard model, automatic loading, position metadata or busy lifecycle.

behavior.name: maximumTwoVisibleLevels
behavior.description: Only top-level comments and one reply list are rendered. Provider descendants deeper than level two are flattened into that reply list in authoritative order and receive a localized visible reply-to label naming their immediate parent context.

behavior.name: authoritativeOrdering
behavior.description: The default supplied record set is oldest first. A target may compose canonical Select for another verified order, but it must return one complete authoritative ordered record set; neutral CSS and runtime never sort records.

behavior.name: finitePagination
behavior.description: Long discussions use canonical finite numbered Pagination. The target owns page count, URLs, current page, replacement, history, scroll, focus and announcements; infinite Feed and unbounded insertion are outside v1.

behavior.name: commentIdentity
behavior.description: Each rendered article is distinguishable from visible author plus optional date and contains non-empty target-sanitized content. The target owns stable IDs, identity privacy, timestamps, localization, language, direction and trust policy.

behavior.name: controlledReactionArrays
behavior.description: Each record supplies one ordered array of zero, one or multiple reactions. Every item provides stable id, complete localized label, optional icon, optional authoritative count, selected state and availability. Empty omits the surface. Activation emits a request and the target returns the complete authoritative array, independently preserving selections or atomically enforcing mutual exclusion without a public single/multiple mode.

behavior.name: targetReplyLifecycle
behavior.description: Reply controls appear only when a target-authenticated composer and moderation lifecycle exist. Targets with a flat native model may omit reply controls and nesting without fabricating unsupported relationships.

behavior.name: targetComposer
behavior.description: The optional slot composes a native named form from canonical controls. Draft ownership, validation, authentication, permissions, sanitization, moderation, persistence, pending/error/result announcement, authoritative count, insertion and focus restoration remain target-owned.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Non-empty visible localized discussion heading; blank omits the complete root.

properties.name: count
properties.description: Optional target-formatted authoritative static count text; not automatically derived or announced.

properties.name: orderControl
properties.description: Optional canonical Select that emits an order request; the target supplies the replacement ordered thread.

properties.name: thread
properties.description: Non-null target discussion composition containing either the authoritative native ordered thread or canonical resolved Empty State; absence omits the complete root.

properties.name: pagination
properties.description: Optional canonical finite numbered Pagination for a long non-empty discussion.

properties.name: composer
properties.description: Optional target-owned top-level native form composed from canonical Textarea and Button controls.

accessibility: Require a non-empty visible title and non-null discussion slot, then name the native section from that heading through aria-labelledby.
Represent records with ol and direct li items, one native article per comment and at most one nested ol reply list; do not rely on indentation alone.
Flatten provider depths beyond two into the second list in authoritative order and expose visible localized reply-to context naming the immediate parent.
Give each comment article a distinguishing name from visible author plus optional visible date; preserve native time datetime and complete localized target text.
Hide a redundant Avatar when adjacent visible author text identifies the same person.

Render reactions as native standalone Toggle buttons with complete localized names, boolean aria-pressed and native disabled state; optional icon and count never replace the label, and an empty array renders no group.
Do not wrap target-controlled reaction buttons in the exclusive canonical Toggle Group because neutral reaction policy intentionally permits independent or target-enforced mutually exclusive arrays.

Compose optional order and pagination from canonical Select and Pagination, preserving their native keyboard, focus, current-page and URL contracts while the target owns result replacement and announcements.
Use canonical Empty State only for resolved zero records; loading, error, moderation lock and unavailable require distinct target-owned page compositions.

Show reply actions only with an authenticated target composer and lifecycle. The optional top-level composer uses a named native form, visible canonical labels, explicit submit and accessible pending/error/success feedback.
Do not add role=feed unless a target separately implements and verifies automatic loading, focus navigation, position, set-size and busy-state semantics.

web.notes: Finite two-level document structure, controlled standalone reaction toggles, canonical Select/Empty State/Pagination/Button/Textarea composition and intrinsic container-relative CSS are implemented with zero L11 runtime; targets own all records and mutation lifecycles.

shopify.notes: Article-only Theme Editor section maps published article.comments, canonical finite Pagination, canonical Empty State and the native new_comment form with exact author/email/body names, localization and moderation/result feedback. Shopify remains flat and deliberately omits replies and reactions.
